sloka: अत्रोद्यानानि शून्यानि प्रलीनविहगानि च ।न चाभिरामानारामान् पश्यामि मनुजर्षभ ॥२-५९-९॥
transliteration: atrodyānāni śūnyāni pralīnavihagāni ca ।na cābhirāmānārāmān paśyāmi manujarṣabha ॥2-59-9॥

translations.english: Water in rivers, ponds and lakes has heated up while all the foliage in the forests and gardens have shrivelled.
